name: idea.to_calendar
description: Puts an idea on the calendar where it lands: the day asked for if it is ahead and holds no post, else the first empty day after this week, since a shoot needs lead time. Refused when the next four months are full.
sql:
update brandbase.ideas i set
  day = brandbase.landing_day(:brand, brandbase.today(:brand, :now::timestamptz), :preferDay::date),
  why = :why, version = i.version + 1, updated_at = now()
where i.id = :id and i.brand_id = :brand
returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(i)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(i.created_at), 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(i.updated_at)) as result
